name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Soft Heat Saunas were one of the original infrared sauna companies and were the first company to bring the health and wellness benefits into people’s homes on a large scale. At Infrared Saunas we are delighted to now sell Soft Heat Sauna products through our website.



The health benefits of Soft Heat Sauna’s are extensive. Regular users get pain relief from a list of ailments such as arthritis and sports injury and skin complaints such as acne, eczema and psoriasis can also be treated. Soft Heat Saunas use Far Infrared technology to target weight loss.



Soft Heat Sauna suits have been designed to create a luxurious experience while your body benefits from the health and wellness improvements. The Soft Heat Sauna heaters warm up in under five minutes which means you can be reaping the health benefits in moments. All Soft Heat Saunas have quality speakers built in so whatever your choice in music, you can personalise your relaxation experience. Soft Heat Saunas are the world’s largest portable infrared saunas with deep benches for your comfort and large doors and windows creating a greater feeling of spaciousness.
